title: Tp Homes with GUI
description: Adds a GUI-based home system with up to 10 teleport points. Use /homes to open the inventory GUI with beds and dye buttons to set, teleport, and delete homes.
body:
## Homes GUI Plugin

A simple and clean home system for Spigot/Paper servers.

### Features
- Up to 10 home points per player
- Beautiful GUI with beds and dye buttons
- Blue bed = home set, Black bed = empty
- Click bed to teleport
- Click dye to set or delete home
- Confirmation GUI before deleting

### Commands
- /homes - Open the homes GUI

### Requirements
- Spigot or Paper 1.19+
